entry.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement: holds rates at 5.25-5.50 percent
entry.summary: The Federal Open Market Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5-1/4 to 5-1/2 percent. The Committee seeks to achieve maximum employment and inflation at the rate of 2 percent over the longer run.

entry.title: FOMC projects one rate cut in 2024, cuts outlook from three
entry.summary: Updated Summary of Economic Projections (SEP) shows median fed funds rate projection of 5.1 percent for 2024, implying one 25 basis points cut versus the March projection of three cuts.
